resources.string: Settings, made simple
A new first page, and every page in short groups.
Search, your account and Performance mode at the top
17 pages in five groups, each with a line that says how it\'s set
Choices open in a sheet, with an example of each
Reset this page puts one page back the way it came
Tap ⓘ to read what a setting does
Lyrics, right on time
Lyrics late on your headphones? Move every song\'s lyrics a little earlier or later.
Up to half a second either way, changed at once
Lyrics in the notification, no car needed
In the car, a long line can carry on into a second line
The lock screen, in the player\'s look
Your lock screen player can take the player\'s background, progress bar and accent.
Turn on \"%1$s\" in %2$s
Moving backgrounds hold still there
A heart on the Lyrics layout when Like is shown
Find the playing song
In a long list, jump straight to the song that\'s playing.
\"%1$s\" in a song list\'s ⋯ menu
Or a button above the mini player: turn on \"%1$s\"
Full-width pictures on albums too
Sort Library\'s albums by when you added them
Swiping song rows to the queue can be turned off
Shuffle without Smart Shuffle, and keep shuffle on for the next list
Replay for yesterday, last week and last month
A solid color as a screen\'s background
Seeking no longer loses a song\'s crossfade
Text no longer shows through Liquid Glass bars
